{{Wireless adapter |brand=Lite-On |model=WN4300A |is_manuf=No |if=USB (non-standard connector) |if_bus_version=2.0 |chip1_brand=Atheros |chip1_model=AR2524;AR2524-AQ1C |chip2_brand=Atheros |chip2_model=AR2124 |accessible_UART=No |802dot11_protocols=bg |oui=00:22:5F }} HP Part no. 1150-7931 (it is used with some HP printers)
Atheros branded ZD1211B (AR2524)
also known as: [[HP RSVLD-0707]]
This adapter probably isn't supported by the standard zd1211rw Linux kernel driver (lacks support for AR2124 RFIC chip), however may be supported by this ZyDAS Linux driver: [https://wikidevi.wi-cat.ru/files/ZyDAS/ZD1211_USB/Linux/LinuxUSB_AR2524-3.0.0.56.tgz LinuxUSB_AR2524-3.0.0.56.tgz]
